status_note: Cue sheet by S11; nothing generated. The runner generates only the three one_off_cues (one take each, D-011) into this folder and logs credits in sound/manifest.jsonl; every other cue is a series library file from content/series1/sound/.
sources: content/series1/episodes/s1b01/script.en.json (same beats and line ids; sfx_notes identical)
timebase: Anchored to beat and line ids, not seconds: no storyboard or measured takes exist yet. Offsets ('~1.0 s into b2') are against the script's silent_seconds; S13 places every point effect against the measured voice and the edited shot lengths (D-014 rule 6, D-0M2). Both language cuts use the same cues and the same anchors; only the line timings differ.

one_off_cues.prompt: A single thin wooden toothpick dropping onto an asphalt road at night, landing with two or three tiny dry ticks as it bounces, very close microphone, quiet still night air behind it, no voices, no music.
one_off_cues.why_not_library: The library's sfx_toothpick_click is a click between teeth or fingers (s1e01 b5); the library itself lists this tarmac drop as an s1b01 one-off.

one_off_cues.prompt: A wooden chair scraping a short way across a hard stone floor in a small room as a man is pushed down onto it, one creak of the wooden joints as his weight lands, close and dry, no voices, no music.
one_off_cues.why_not_library: Listed by the library as an s1b01 one-off; no chair sound elsewhere in the series.

one_off_cues.prompt: A single page of a small paper notebook being turned slowly, soft dry paper sound, close and quiet, small quiet room, no voices, no music.
one_off_cues.why_not_library: Listed by the library as an s1b01 one-off; sfx_photo_print and sfx_paper_fold_crinkle are a photo and a paper fold, not a page.

in_out: b1, b2: no music. The episode opens inside s1e02's closing in-breath; s1e02's pulse was cut to silence there, so s1b01 starts on the bed and the call only.
mus_bed_drone in with the first boot at b3 head; under b3, b4, b5; 2 s fade out on the last word of l12.
b5a, b6, b7: no music (time cut carried by the overlay; b7 is engine and keys alone).
mus_tension_pulse in on the hasp crack at b8 head; held low under all of Mausi's scenes (b8-b11).
Cut dead on the last word of l28 with the picture; then 0.5 s of bedroom room tone only, then end.
music.glimpse_B: Glimpse B ends on l19: it uses this sheet from its own start to the end of l19, then cuts pulse and bed dead with the picture. No glimpse-only sound.

ducking: l01: locked line, one whole take, no cut-off; bed ducked 6 dB, nothing else under it.
Ambience beds duck 6 dB under every line; music ducks 8 dB (drone) or 6 dB (pulse) under ordinary lines.
l19: bed and pulse duck 10 dB; nothing else under it (padlock knocks finish before it).
l28: bed and pulse duck right down (12 dB) so every word is clear; the crinkle and bangle sit in the gap between its two sentences.
Point effects never sit on a word; when a measured take moves, the effect moves to the nearest gap.
voice_processing: l02 (Mausi, Kiran's phone on speaker in the bedroom): band-pass ~300-3400 Hz, light saturation, light colour, every consonant survives (library mix.phone_voice_fx).
l10, l11 (Mausi on Billu's phone at his ear on the landing): same band-pass, a little more colour than l02; fully voiced; plus the landing reverb at low send.

l07 (Billu): the script's sfx_notes ask for loud, through the door, muffled but clear on the bedroom side. Set-up 1 is the landing shot, so: dry and close with landing reverb while the picture is on the landing; if the edit puts any of l07 over the bedroom plate, that part gets a gentle low-pass (~4 kHz) at the same level. S13 to judge this against the cut.
l09 (Billu on the landing, on the phone): landing reverb, unfiltered.
l12 (Billu through the door crack): loud and close, dry, slight landing reverb. Not muffled.
l19 (Mausi through the shut door): lightly muffled (low-pass ~5 kHz, small door resonance), fully voiced, warm and clear.
b3-b5 bedroom lines and b4 l08: bedroom, dry. b4 set-up 1 and b5: landing reverb, small and hard (mix setting, not a cue).
mix.perspective: Bedroom-side perspective for everything outside the door (boots, keys, car, landing creak): low-passed and quieter. From b9, the door is open: a low landing spill (amb_stairwell_landing at -34 dB) joins the bedroom bed.
silences: b10: after l23, 0.8 s with no answer: bedroom bed and held pulse only, no effect.
b11: 0.5 s of bedroom room tone after l28's last word, music already cut.
mix.no_fan: No ceiling fan in any part of this mix (library mix.no_fan_rule).
mix.levels_note: level_db values are starting points relative to full scale before the -14 LUFS master; S13 sets final levels by ear-proxy measurement against dialogue.

fallback: If a one-off fails or comes back unusable after its one take: toothpick tarmac -> sfx_toothpick_click slice at -20 dB; chair scrape -> drop (the hands on the shoulders carry it); page turn -> a short slice of sfx_paper_fold_crinkle. If music fails, plan 7.8: raise the bedroom bed 3 dB in b3-b5 and b8-b11.
